target_customer: Video creators, filmmakers, podcasters and small production teams who edit footage; earlier framing also targeted sports broadcasters and leagues
problem: Video editing is slow and manual. Narrative lets users upload clips, describe the edit in plain language and get an editable timeline.
business_model: Freemium SaaS with paid tiers on web and iOS; also a clipping API for sports per one source

founders.name: Erik Vank
prior_employers: Apple (per profile headline on YC page)

founders.name: Aryan Sawhney
founders.background_notes: YC page lists roles at RevisionDojo, Logseq and Candor; the launch post says the team did research at Brown and UW and scaled consumer apps to 2M users, not assigned to individuals.

technical_complexity.rationale: Agentic editing on top of video models and timelines needs video processing, rendering and editing UI work, which is substantial but standard for the period.

defensibility.rationale: Many AI editors existed and LLM driven editing is easy to replicate; no network effect or data lock-in described.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition found; large editors were adding AI features, but I found no dated source confirming specific launches.

market_need_then: Short-form and creator video demand is large and editing is time consuming; testimonials on the site name creators and a wedding filmmaker using it. No independent demand data was found.

branding.domain_note: Uses usenarrative.ai with a 'use' prefix because narrative.io belongs to an unrelated data company; sources also mention narrative.video.

identity.logo: Not described by any source found
identity.voice_and_tone: Plain product language; YC launch frames it as 'Cursor for professional video editing'

branding.community_and_virality: Listed on Product Hunt; testimonials from creators with 19K to 291K followers on the site.

brand_strength.rationale: Generic real word that needs a prefix domain and clashes with other Narrative companies; limited brand press.

outcome_analysis: Narrative is an active YC Fall 2025 company with three founders and early creator testimonials. Sources disagree on whether its focus is general video editing or sports highlights, funding is unverified and no exit has occurred, so no success or failure factors are assigned yet.
notes: Funding unverified: VCBacked says $500K pre-seed, Preqin and Yespress say undisclosed seed in 2025-11 from Y Combinator and Pioneer Fund; no primary announcement. Competitor searches returned only undated vendor pages (Opus Clip, Descript, Submagic, Shootsta), so the list is empty. YC page lists New York City; some aggregators say San Francisco. Completeness pass: the 2025-11 seed from Y Combinator and Pioneer Fund rests on a single outlet (Yespress, also Preqin); VCBacked says 500K pre-seed, so the amount is left null.
